tools.name: search
tools.description: Find prop firms, brokers, crypto exchanges and open datasets on TradingLookup by name or topic. Returns matches with their page address. Use get_facts or get_dataset next.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: The dated facts TradingLookup publishes for one prop firm, broker or crypto exchange (for example cheapest plan, profit split, platforms), each read from the firm's own pages, with the page to cite. If the firm issued TradingLookup a discount code, it is included with our disclosure.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Every open dataset TradingLookup publishes (CC BY 4.0): prop firm prices and rules, CFD loss rates, broker and exchange fees, market calendars and macro series. Returns id, name, page and data date.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: One dataset in full: what it holds, its files with columns and row counts, the download addresses, the licence and how to cite it.

tools.name: read_rows
tools.description: Rows from one CSV file of a dataset, at most 50 a call. Filter with "where" (column: text the value must contain). Files over 200 KB are not read whole: filter by firm_slug to read one firm, or use the download address in the result.

tools.name: get_promo_code
tools.description: The discount code a prop firm issued to TradingLookup, if we hold one: the code, what it gives, the date the firm issued it, the firm's own website and our page for it. Leave "firm" empty to list every code we hold. We only list codes the firm gave us; if we hold none for a firm, it says so.

tools.name: find_prop_firms
tools.description: Prop firm plans that cost least to reach a funded account, one plan per firm, from each firm's own pages. Filter by market, account size, country (firms whose own list names it are left out), news-trading rule, platform and budget. Prices are without any promo code; cost_to_funded_usd is price plus

tools.name: get_rule_changes
tools.description: What changed in TradingLookup's record of one prop firm's rules and prices between our weekly reads of its own pages, newest first: old and new value, date, the firm's page and an Internet Archive copy. A row means our recorded value differed between two reads.

tools.name: is_market_open
tools.description: Whether a stock exchange is open now or at a given time, from the exchange's own published hours and holidays: NYSE, Nasdaq, London (LSE), India (NSE, BSE), Pakistan (PSX), Nigeria (NGX), Johannesburg (JSE), Saudi (Tadawul), Dubai (DFM) and CME FX futures. Gives today's sessions in the exchange's lo

tools.name: compare_prop_firms
tools.description: Two to four prop firms side by side from each firm's own pages: cheapest plan at the account size asked, cost to reach funded, profit split, drawdown, platforms, news-trading rule and the date we read them. Prices are without any promo code. Each firm links its facts page to cite.

tools.name: check_country_access
tools.description: For one country, which futures or forex prop firms' own restricted-country lists name it and which do not, with the date we read each list and its source. Or, with "firm", what one firm's list says about that country. A firm not naming a country is not a promise it will accept a trader there.

tools.name: get_payout_proof
tools.description: What public evidence shows a prop firm pays its traders, in TradingLookup's Payout Proof record: the payout total the firm prints, any share of funded traders paid, payouts an outside tracker counts, and stablecoin payouts we count on public blockchains from addresses the firm publishes. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_facts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The dated facts TradingLookup publishes for one prop firm, broker or crypto exchange (for example cheapest plan, profit split, platforms), each read from the firm's own pages, with the page to cite." → after: "The dated facts TradingLookup publishes for one prop firm, broker or crypto exchange (for example cheapest plan, profit split, platforms), each read from the firm's own pages, with the page to cite. If the firm issued TradingLookup a discount code, it is included with our disclosure."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
